name: pi-graph-tool
description: Graph engineering extension for Pi: adds graph_run tool that lets the agent autonomously organize subtasks into a DAG — same-wave parallelism, multi-wave topological scheduling, and node-to-node data routing via {{id}} placeholders (with contract retry and failure cascade). v0.2.4: optional execution tracing (PI_GRAPH_TRACE_DIR) + bundled zero-dependency wave-visualization UI (ui/).
